crawlNote: Help homepage is a thin shell. Escalation matrix fetched. Help-article body content beyond that matrix was not crawled.
summary: Groww publishes named officers and SEBI / ODR links. That is stronger than most consumer apps. The help homepage itself almost does not exist, and “24×7” sits next to weekday-only CX leadership hours.

findings.title: 24×7 support claim next to weekday leadership hours
findings.whyItHurts: A customer who escalates on Saturday will read 24×7, then hit a Mon–Fri officer line. Say which layer is 24×7.
findings.fix: “L1 chat/phone 24×7. Named officers Mon–Fri 9–5 IST.” One sentence.

evidence.quote: We are available 24*7 to resolve your issue.

findings.title: Help homepage is a shell
findings.whyItHurts: The URL customers guess first is /help. What we fetched is “What's new / Feedback / Grievance”. The real matrix is buried under a long slug.
findings.fix: Put search, top 10 tasks, and the phone number on /help. Link the matrix from there in one tap.
